basic_info.description: This remarkable home is shaped by nearly two decades of thoughtful remodeling, where every space has been designed with purpose and care. The seamless flow between kitchen, dining, and living spaces keeps everyone connected. Abundant counters, storage, and a seated island make cooking and entertaining effortless. Spa-like bathrooms bring a sense of retreat, while the expansive upstairs bedrooms reveal soothing westward views of sunsets. The primary en suite, complete with a gas fireplace, sitting area, and garden access, offers its own private sanctuary. Sunlight fills this house throughout the day, highlighting the home's history and character. That enduring sense of warmth and distinction has long made this a residence of choice for those drawn to both comfort and character.    With its rare mix of privacy, light-filled rooms, open flow, and unbeatable location, it's easy to see why iconic San Francisco figures once resided here, including actor Danny Glover and Giants pitcher Sergio Romo. And while its history adds sparkle, it is the everyday rhythm of life here that makes the home unforgettable. All set within steps of Golden Gate Park, neighborhood markets, and hidden trails. A rare blend of story, setting, and style.
